policy: Every confirmed bug class receives a permanent machine-checkable guard when practical.

patterns.description: Tests must import the canonical REPORT_SCHEMA constant rather than duplicate a numeric schema version.
Reproducibility tests must use canonical ModuleMetadata, ProofStatus and PortSpec types so contract evolution is exercised directly.
Qualification overlay tests must derive canonical qualification provenance instead of pinning a previously promoted attested commit in a QUALIFIED_COMMIT-style oracle.
